rubric.instructions: Score this headline and snippet from 0 (irrelevant) to 10 (must-read) for a music-tech industry professional who tracks: AI tools for music creation/distribution/rights, streaming platform economics and policy, major-label and artist business deals, and emerging music tech startups. Penalize celebrity gossip, tour/show announcements with no business angle, and minor rehashes of stories already widely covered.

criteria.signal: AI in music: generation, mastering, rights management, detection
Streaming economics: royalties, DSP policy changes, platform strategy
M&A, funding rounds, or major partnerships in music tech
Shifts in how artists release, market, or monetize music
General trend pieces without a clear actionable insight

exclude: Celebrity gossip with no business angle
Local concert or tour date announcements
Opinion pieces unrelated to technology or business strategy
